title: Bologna Children’s Book Fair 2026
summary: Our third year with our own stand, in the international publishers’ hall.
body:
Our third year with our own stand brought a new location in the international publishers’ hall and meetings with longstanding partners and publishers we were meeting for the first time.

[Read our report from the fair](/news/bologna-childrens-book-fair-2026/)
